text: Environmental design is an interdisciplinary field that integrates architecture, landscape design, interior design, humanistic aesthetics and engineering technology, aiming to optimize the functionality and aesthetic experience of human living Spaces through planning and design. It covers full-scale design from indoor Spaces (such as residential and commercial Spaces) to outdoor environments (such as parks and urban squares), focusing on the practicality, ecology and cultural nature of the space, and addressing the issue of "how to make the space not only meet the usage requirements but also convey humanistic spirit and harmony with nature".
